findings.note: He introduced the Vote by Mail Protection Act (H.R. 8666). Per his press release, it would invalidate Executive Order 14399 on mail-in voting and bar the Postal Service and other federal agencies from spending funds to carry the order out. The order, as he describes it, would have the Postal Service refuse ballots from voters not named on newly created federal voter lists.
